measurement_limits: Cooperative host lock and affinity; no administrator-exclusive core reservation.
Aggregate per-CPU ticks measure activity; process last_processor is only the last observed CPU, not a per-CPU runtime attribution.
Process-level counters/affinity and main-thread last_processor are sampled; no per-thread runtime attribution is claimed.
Active-process details are explicitly bounded; every detected known native conflict is retained.
Observer runs on a separate CPU and shares host memory/I/O; its measured sampling cost is reported.
RSS sum double-counts shared pages and does not replace the frozen per-job8GiB process-tree resource guard.
sampling_measurement_scope: Per-sample collection before JSON serialization; total process CPU includes bookkeeping and writes
